ai_summary: CESC Limited reported a fire incident at its Panihati Distribution Sub-station on September 13, 2026, which was promptly controlled with no casualties and minimal disruption, as 100% power supply was restored within 3.5 hours. The company has insurance coverage for the affected plant and machinery, significantly mitigating potential financial impacts, and no major red flags were identified regarding long-term operational continuity or financial health.
